steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to a Legends' guard at the Legends' Guild east of the Ardougne lodestone.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

actions.text: Can I speak to someone in charge?
Can I go on the quest?
Yes, I'd like to talk to Grand Vizier Erkle.

steps.text: Talk to Radimus Erkle.

actions.text: Yes actually, what's involved?

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue talking to Radimus Erkle.

Take 3 papyrus from Radimus' table.
  • You can buy papyrus from the general store next to the Karamja lodestone too.

steps.title: Kharazi Jungle
steps.text: Chop-down the Jungle Trees/Bushes south of Shilo Village (fairy ring CKR) to access the Kharazi Jungle.
Stand on the marked tile and right click complete the Radimus notes.

Repeat in the centre of the jungle.
  • Optional: Repair fairy ring CJS with five bittercap mushrooms to make returning to the jungle easier.
Repeat again on the eastern edge of the jungle.
Use the notes on a jungle forester, south of Shilo Village (fairy ring CKR).

actions.text: Yes, go ahead make a copy!

steps.title: Cave
steps.text: Return to Kharazi Jungle (fairy ring CJS).
Swing the bull roarer until Gujuo appears.
Talk to Gujuo.

actions.text: I was hoping to attract the attention of a native.
I want to develop friendly relations with your people.
Can you get your people together?

postconditions.text: it does not seem to work

actions.text: What can we do instead then?
How do we make the totem pole?
I will release Ungadulu...

steps.text: Search the mossy rocks in the north-west of the jungle.

actions.text: Yes, I'll crawl through, I'm very athletic.

steps.text: Investigate the fire wall.

actions.text: How can I extinguish the flames?
Where do I get pure water from?

steps.text: Exit the cave.
Swing the bull roarer until Gujuo appears.
Talk to Gujuo.

actions.text: I need some pure water to douse some magic flames.
Where is the pool of sacred water?
What kind of a vessel?
Ok thanks for your help.

steps.text: Search the mossy rocks in the north-west of the jungle.

actions.text: Yes, I'll crawl through, I'm very athletic.

steps.text: Search the eastern bookcase.

actions.text: Yes please!

steps.text: Search the ancient gate.
Smash-to-bits the three boulders (drop the rocks).
Open the Ancient Gate.

actions.text: Yes, I'm very strong, I'll force them open.

steps.text:
Jump-over the jagged wall.
  • Optional: Kill a death wing for a hard Karamja achievement.
Search the marked wall.

actions.text: Yes, I'll read it.

steps.text:
Use your runes on it in order according to your version:
  • English: Soul, Mind, Earth, Law, Law.
  • German: Air, Earth, Blood, Earth, Nature.
  • French: Law, Air, Death, Mind, Blood.
  • Portuguese: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Law.
steps.warning: Tracking is designed for en only.

actions.text: Yes, I'll go through!

steps.text: Use the cut sapphire on the carved rock.
Use the cut diamond on the carved rock.
Use the cut ruby on the carved rock.
Use the cut red topaz on the carved rock.
Use the cut jade on the carved rock.
Use the cut emerald on the carved rock.
Use the cut opal on the carved rock.
Wait for the cutscene.
Take the Binding book.

steps.title: Sacred pool
steps.text: Use 2 gold bars on any anvil with the sketch in your inventory.
steps.warning: Bring extra bars in case it fails.

actions.text: Golden bowl

steps.text: Enter the Kharazi Jungle.
Swing the bull roarer until Gujuo appears.
Talk to Gujuo.

actions.text: Yes, I'd like you to bless my gold bowl.

steps.text: 'Cut-Reed' on the tall reeds next to the water pool.
Use the hollow reed on the water pool.
Enchant-Vials with the binding book to create an enchanted vial.
Use the hollow reed on the Water Pool again.
Search the mossy rocks in the north-west of the jungle.

actions.text: Yes, I'll crawl through, I'm very athletic.

steps.text: Use the golden bowl on the fire wall.
Use the binding book on Ungadulu.
Kill Nezikchened. He will blast the player for up to 2500 typeless damage when he dies.
Talk to Ungadulu.

actions.text: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo.
How do I grow the Yommi tree?
What will you do now?
Ok, thanks...

steps.text: Touch the fire wall.
Exit the cave.
Use the golden bowl on the seeds.
Use the seeds on a patch of fertile soil.
Use the hollow reed on the pool.
Swing the bull roarer until Gujuo appears.
Talk to Gujuo.
steps.warning: Switch to the standard spellbook if you are not already on it after talking to him.

actions.text: The water pool has dried up and I need more water.
Where is the source of the spring of pure water?

postconditions.text: never go near such a place

actions.text: If I went, could you help me?
Ok thanks for your help.

steps.title: Restoring the pool
steps.text: Search palm trees for grimy ardrigal and clean it.

neededItems.name: Runes for any Charge Orb Spell

steps.text: Search some marshy jungle vines for a grimy snake weed.
Use the ardrigal and snake weed on a vial of water for a bravery potion.
Enter the Kharazi Jungle.
Search the mossy rocks in the north-west of the jungle.

actions.text: Yes, I'll crawl through, I'm very athletic.

steps.text:
Traverse the dungeon as before to where you found the Binding book:
  • Search the eastern Bookcase.
  • Choose the Search option on the Ancient Gate.
  • Smash-to-bits the three Boulders.
  • Open the Ancient Gate.
  • Move past the Death wings.
  • Choose the Jump-over option on Jagged wall.
  • Use the Marked wall.

actions.text: Yes, I'm very strong, I'll force them open.

steps.text: Cast a charge orb spell on the north Ancient Gate.
Smash the barrels for a rope.

Use the Rope on the Winch.
  • If you forgot your rope, you can smash the barrels in the room for one.
Drink the bravery potion.

actions.text: Yes, I'll bravely drink the bravery potion.

steps.text: Search and then climb-down the Winch.

actions.text: Yes, I'll shimmy down the rope into possible doom.

steps.title: Restoring the pool (part 2)
steps.text: Climb-over the rocky ledges and rocks to reach the bottom. If you fall, skip to the next step.

actions.text: Yes, I can think of nothing more exciting!
Yes, I want to climb over the rocks.

steps.text: Kill San Tojalon.
Kill Irvig Senay.
Kill Ranalph Devere.
Use each crystal on the north-east furnace.
Use the heart crystal on the searchable mossy rock in the middle of the room.
Run south and use the heart crystal on the recess next to the shimmering field.
Walk-through the shimmering field.
Push the boulder.

actions.text: Who's asking?
What can I do about that?
I'll do what I must to get the water.
Ok, I'll do it.

steps.text: Walk-through the shimmering field.
Climb back up the cliff. Good luck!

actions.text: Yes, I can think of nothing more exciting!
Yes, I want to climb over the rocks.

steps.text: Equip the Dark dagger then take the Blue hat.
Kill Viyeldi. Attack him during the dialogue. He will disappear after completing the dialogue.

Return to the boulders and push one.
  • You can unequip the dagger.

actions.text: Yes, I can think of nothing more exciting!
Yes, I want to climb over the rocks.

steps.text: Kill Nezikchened.

Push all three boulders.
  • All three must be pushed while standing on the east side of them.
  • If one does not move, Push it from a different angle.
Return to the Kharazi Jungle (fairy ring CJS).
Use the hollow reed on the water pool.
Use the yommi tree seeds on the fertile soil.
Wait for the tree to grow a bit.
Use the Golden bowl on the partially grown tree.
Chop the Adult Yommi tree.
Trim the Felled Yommi tree.
Carve the Trimmed Yommi.
Lift the Totem pole.

steps.title: The final fight
steps.text: Use your Yommi totem on the Totem Pole east of the pool.
steps.warning: Heal up before using the totem.

steps.text:
Defeat Nezikchened and the three skeletons.
  • He will appear four times, with a skeleton spawning between each kill.
Use the Yommi totem on the Totem Pole again.
Talk to Gujuo to receive the gilded totem.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Enter the Legends' Guild courtyard.
Talk to Radimus at the Legends' Guild.

postconditions.text: meet you in the main hall

steps.text: Talk to Radimus again inside the guild.

actions.text: Yes, I'll train now.
